written: 2026-10-28, before any regime result was computed
purpose: Per-regime (bull / side / bear) scorecard of the R9 batch candidates (33) and five bundles. Elimination diagnostic only; not evidence of passing; DEV data is already used for selection so this is not an independent test.
data: DEV only: S1 2021-04-01..2023-09-18 (all 9 symbols) and S2 2024-07-15..2025-10-20 (BTC excluded, its paper window), reads checked by strong_search_dev.assert_allowed. No validation / locked / IW1 / paper window.
cost: measured alt cost record run/audit/alt_cost_measured_20261027/estimate_v3_alts.json (PE-ed757f47..., ESTIMATED_FROM_PUBLIC_DATA); extra rows: gross (cost 0) and assumed_public_v1
series: basket-average daily net bp (each symbol equal weight, same as ADR 0036/0042). PRIMARY attribution: each trade to the UTC day of its ENTRY (what a live regime switch could know). SECONDARY: exit day.
regime_index: equal-weight daily-rebalanced close-to-close index of the segment's symbols (S2 without BTC). Label of day d uses closes up to day d-1 only. Same rules as ADR 0026 so results are comparable.

regimes.R1_trend: trailing 90-day index return >= +20% BULL, <= -20% BEAR, else SIDE; first 90 days of a segment NA (S2 has only 26 warm-up days so S2 R1 starts about 2024-09-17)
regimes.R2_drawdown: index <= 75% of its running peak (peak since segment read_start) DD else OK

bundles.B1_first5: R9 ranks 1-5 (the ADR 0042 v3 rehearsal members)
bundles.B3_top5_S1: 5 candidates with highest S1 net SR under the measured cost (selected on S1, so S1 numbers are inflated; flagged)
bundles.B4_long_only: the long candidates among the 33 (27), equal weight

stats: days, mean bp/day, annual SR (only if >= 60 days in the regime, else 'insufficient'), cumulative bp, trades, trade hit rate; bundles also Newey-West(5) t of mean. Basket buy-and-hold gross mean bp/day per regime as context.

flags.REGIME_ALL3_POS: S1 mean bp/day > 0 in BULL, SIDE and BEAR (each >= 60 days)
flags.BEAR_NEG: S1 mean bp/day <= 0 in R1 BEAR
flags.DD_NEG: S1 mean bp/day <= 0 in R2 DD
flags.ONE_REGIME: more than 100% of S1 cumulative profit comes from a single R1 regime (i.e. the other two together lose)
flags.S2_SAME_SIGN: S2 sign of mean bp/day in each regime with >= 60 days matches S1

no_threshold_changes: Statistical criteria, preregs v2/v3, cost profiles, engine untouched. The scorecard may eliminate candidates in discussion only; it never promotes anything.
